title: Self-serve DPA toggle & subprocessor visibility pilot for EU/UK customers
creator: Asha Menon
description: Pilot enabling enterprise customers in EU/UK to self-select data processing options (DPA toggles) during onboarding and to view an auditable subprocessor list with timestamps. The pilot couples feature toggles with a tiered pricing overlay so sales/finance can A/B pricing impact for opt-in data residency and SCC activation.
background: Enterprise prospects frequently ask for: (1) a straightforward way to opt into more restrictive data processing terms during signup, (2) visibility into subprocessors and their last-attested dates, and (3) predictable pricing for added compliance. Legal has been fielding custom DPA requests that add friction to sales. This pilot aims to reduce manual contract work and measure conversion/cost tradeoffs.
proposed_solution: Build a self-serve DPA flow in the Console that presents three mutually exclusive tiers: Standard (hosted API with default retention), European Residency (data pinned to EU/UK regions + SCCs auto-applied), and Enterprise Residency (dedicated storage + stricter retention). A linked subprocessor registry UI will show current subprocessors, last attestation date, and a downloadable snapshot (CSV + immutable hash). Selecting higher tiers triggers an automated pricing quote calculator and appends standard DPA/SCC annex text to the customer agreement.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature gate and internal demo (week 1-2). 2) Soft pilot with 5 existing EU/UK customers recruited by Sales (week 3-6). 3) Measure conversion, legal touchpoints avoided, and cost delta. 4) Iterate UI/flow and expand to 20 customers. 5) Bake into public Console with billing SKU toggles if metrics meet threshold.
acceptance_criteria:
- Console shows DPA tier selector during account setup and in Settings.
- Subprocessor registry displays current list with attestation dates and allows CSV export.
- Selecting EU/UK tiers triggers SCC language in generated DPA and records selection audit.
- Automated quote calculator returns estimated monthly delta and updates billing preview.
- Pilot customers onboarded without manual legal amendment in >=70% of cases.
success_metrics:
- Reduction in legal review cycles for pilot customers (target: 60% fewer manual contract edits).
- Pilot conversion uplift for paid seats when EU/UK residency offered (target: +8%).
- Average time-to-close deal reduction for pilot accounts (target: -10 days).
- Frequency of subprocessor inquiries per customer reduced by 50%.
risks_mitigation:
- Risk: SCC activation may not cover all downstream subprocessors. Mitigation: include explicit exceptions and required manual review path; legal to approve annex template.
- Risk: Pricing calculator underestimates infra delta. Mitigation: cross-check with infra cost model and include conservative margin.
- Risk: Data residency enforcement gaps. Mitigation: pair feature with gating in routing layer and test automated routing to EU regions using synthetic traffic.
engineering_notes: ENG-42111 will implement the backend DPA flag, subprocessor registry API, and export endpoint. Expect 2 API endpoints: /v1/customers/{id}/dpa and /v1/subprocessors?region=eu. Work on audit logging and immutable export hash required. Allocate 3 sprints including QA and soak tests.
design_notes: DES-2045 to deliver a compact DPA selector pattern that fits inside onboarding modal and Settings > Data & Privacy. Provide copy variations for Legal-approved DPA summary. Accessibility review required for modal and CSV export flows.
legal_notes: Draft DPA annex and SCC activation text provided by Legal (confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/dpa/pm-67821-draft). Legal requires that the console stores customer consent and provides exportable DPA records. Security review flagged for KMS integration when Enterprise Residency is selected.
